szoveg_eredeti:
Applications are now open for the Anthropic Residency, a paid, fixed-term research program with placements lasting between six weeks and six months.

We are looking for people who have led ambitious work in a variety of technical fields and want to transition to full-time work on making AI safe and beneficial for everyone. If you are an academic, a technical founder, or a staff-level engineer, we want to hear from you. No ML background is required.

Read more and apply by November 22: https://lnkd.in/gGgmnTmF
